metadata.Name: WikiOmnia
metadata.Description: WikiOmnia is a large Russian QA dataset obtained in a fully automated way. It contains QA pairs and corresponding Russian Wikipedia article summary sections, composed with a fully automated generation and filtration pipeline.
metadata.Paper Title: WikiOmnia: filtration and evaluation of the generated QA corpus on the whole Russian Wikipedia
